parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The accelerated domain name. You can specify only one domain name.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description:
The sorting method. Valid values:

- **traf**: by traffic.

- **pv**: by the number of visits.

Default value: **pv**.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

To query data for a specific day, set this parameter to YYYY-MM-DDT16:00:00Z.

> If you do not set this parameter, data from the last 24 hours is queried.
